summary.en-US: Crash-proof tab session backup and idle tab memory guardian for Firefox.

release_notes.en-US:
0.3.2

Fixed:
- Restore skips privileged URLs instead of aborting; about:blank is kept; Backup now says when the session was unchanged.
- Import accepts a snapshots wrapper and shows an error when nothing was imported.
- Double-click Restore no longer opens the snapshot twice.
- Discard shortcut is Alt+Shift+D (no longer Ctrl+Shift+D).
- Discard all except current unloads tabs in all windows.
- Popup status stays visible; restore-into-current checkbox persists; tab list refreshes after actions.
- Default auto-backup interval is 5 minutes.
- Guardian skips in-use media and known media hosts.
- Crash-restore prompt skips install/update/reload and does not re-fire.
- Dirty-form protection clears on reset and SPA navigation.

Added:
- Live Firefox e2e canary and GitHub Release zip workflow.
